collection.message_membership_rule: Only message summaries carrying the exact user label ID were included; synthetic thread_group values replace Gmail thread IDs.
limitations: The label metadata reports 626 messages, while the search returned 574 labelled message summaries across 511 threads; 52 messages remain unreconciled. Do not claim full message-level completeness until this discrepancy is resolved.
